text.EN: I know food is what I need, but I can't give you an exact amount yet.
text.TL: Alam kong pagkain ang kailangan ko, pero hindi ko pa masabi ang eksaktong dami.

text.EN: Whatever you can spare to eat would be plenty.
text.TL: Kahit anong maibibigay mong makakain ay sapat na.

text.EN: Even one can or a couple rations would keep me going.
text.TL: Kahit isang de-lata o dalawang rasyon ay malaking tulong na.

text.EN: I'm not picky about the portion size, just need food.
text.TL: Hindi ako mapili sa dami, basta may makakain lang.

text.EN: A small portion or a full meal, anything helps.
text.TL: Maliit man o buong pagkain, lahat 'yon makakatulong.

text.EN: Just enough food to fill the hollow feeling in my gut.
text.TL: Sapat lang na pagkain para mapawi ang gutom ko.

text.EN: Don't need a banquet, just whatever food you're willing to share.
text.TL: Hindi kailangan ng marami, kung ano lang ang kaya mong ibahagi.

text.EN: A couple bites would buy me a few more hours of strength.
text.TL: Ilang subo lang ay magbibigay sa akin ng ilang oras na lakas.

text.EN: Hard to name a count. Just give me what you don't need.
text.TL: Mahirap magbilang. Ibigay mo lang kung anong hindi mo kailangan.

text.EN: Any amount of food is better than nothing right now.
text.TL: Anumang dami ng pagkain ay mas maganda kaysa sa wala ngayon.
